def weighted_moments(values: list[float], weights: list[float]) -> list[float]:
    total_w: float = 0.0
    mean: float = 0.0
    i: int = 0
    n: int = len(values)
    while i < n:
        v: float = values[i]
        w: float = weights[i]
        total_w = total_w + w
        mean = mean + v * w
        i = i + 1
    mean = mean / total_w
    var: float = 0.0
    skew: float = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        v = values[i]
        w = weights[i]
        d: float = v - mean
        var = var + w * d * d
        skew = skew + w * d * d * d
        i = i + 1
    var = var / total_w
    if var > 0.0:
        skew = skew / total_w / (var ** 1.5)
    else:
        skew = 0.0
    result: list[float] = [mean, var, skew]
    return result
